question: For what durations or frequency should the auspicious goddess be worshiped?
premises: Worship of the auspicious goddess is prescribed.
A period of six, seven, or eight times/units is mentioned.
Continuous worship is also allowed as an alternative.
inference: One should worship the auspicious goddess for six, seven, or eight periods, or always.
uncertainties: vasu commonly denotes eight; the exact time unit of kāla is not specified.
tvarcayecchivām contains compressed sandhi; parsed as worship of śivām.
plain_english: One should worship the auspicious goddess for six, seven, or eight periods, or at all times.
